purpose: Discovery register for potentially useful open industrial-maintenance knowledge and data. It is not an imported fault database.
policy: Do not copy repository contents or datasets into this project until the exact license, dataset terms, attribution requirements, and provenance are checked. Research papers and public GitHub visibility do not by themselves grant redistribution rights.

sources.title: FZU_HGPFD — hydraulic gear pump fault diagnosis dataset
sources.potentialUse: Research/evaluation of signal-based pump fault classification, not as a text troubleshooting guide.
sources.reportedScope: Gear-pump health/operating states; acoustic and vibration channels; TDMS data.
sources.accessStatus: README indicates external data download route; full dataset not confirmed accessible from repository

sources.title: Machine-Fault-Dataset — index of machine-fault datasets
sources.potentialUse: Discover original datasets and papers for bearings, gears, motors, pumps and other equipment.
sources.reportedScope: Index/catalog; individual linked datasets have separate owners and terms.
sources.licenseStatus: repository and each linked dataset require separate review

sources.title: ManufacturingRagAgent
sources.potentialUse: Study retrieval-grounded answers and abstention when evidence is absent.
sources.reportedScope: PDF retrieval / vector store / LLM example; depends on OpenAI API and associated costs.

sources.title: IIoT Graph RAG
sources.potentialUse: Study equipment hierarchy and relationships between assets, faults and maintenance records.
sources.reportedScope: Graph RAG with ISO 14224-inspired hierarchy and sample data described as generated.
sources.licenseStatus: repository license reported as Other; exact reuse terms unresolved

sources.title: Azure predictive maintenance agents
sources.potentialUse: Study workflow separation, human approval and evidence aggregation.
sources.reportedScope: Azure-dependent agent architecture; not a required runtime dependency for this offline app.
sources.licenseStatus: MIT reported in repository review; re-check exact commit before copying

sources.title: Industrial Ops RAG Agent — multi-equipment fault catalogue
sources.potentialUse: Coverage discovery and schema study only; reviewed data contains 9 equipment types and 55 fault records.
sources.reportedScope: Centrifugal pump, induction motor, control valve, air compressor, shell-and-tube heat exchanger, centrifugal fan, cooling tower, safety valve, gear reducer.
sources.licenseStatus: repository-code-MIT; no separate data license found; several records cite GB/T standards or generic manual without page/revision/model claim traceability
sources.accessStatus: LICENSE, data/knowledge_base.json, data/fault_cases.json and requirements.txt reviewed
sources.qualityNotes: 42/55 records repeat possible_causes as diagnosis_steps; one case record only; generic maintenance schedules lack scope. Do not treat these as validated tests or instructions.

sources.title: BearingDatasets — normalized bearing and rotating machinery datasets
sources.potentialUse: Offline research benchmark adapter for bearings and rotating machinery.
sources.reportedScope: README reports 69 datasets; common metadata format; vibration/acoustic signals, labels and operating metadata. Each dataset is downloaded from original source.
sources.licenseStatus: repository code MIT; every dataset retains its own original license and must be checked separately
sources.accessStatus: README and LICENSE reviewed; package requires Python >=3.10; data not bundled in repository

sources.title: Awesome Industrial Datasets
sources.potentialUse: Discover original datasets across industrial domains; not a fault database.
sources.reportedScope: README reports 199 datasets across manufacturing, chemical/process, mechanical, oil/gas, energy, robotics and OT security.
sources.licenseStatus: catalogue CC-BY-NC-4.0; each linked dataset has separate terms

sources.title: IDTA Asset Administration Shell Metamodel
sources.potentialUse: Reference for normalized equipment identity, properties, relationships and documents; map a compact subset to local app schema.
sources.reportedScope: IDTA-01001 metamodel with JSON, RDF and XML schemas.
sources.licenseStatus: README declares CC-BY-4.0 and links license; confirm release-specific notice before reuse
sources.accessStatus: README reviewed; v3.2 release identified in README

sources.title: PlantCraft — industrial historian and analytics suite
sources.potentialUse: Study asset/signal/alarms lineage, offline installation, read-only OT integration and auditability.
sources.reportedScope: Historian, analytics, alarms, dashboards, process models, documents and read-only assistant access.

sources.title: pgmpy — probabilistic graphical models
sources.potentialUse: Offline comparison prototype for Bayesian networks, dynamic Bayesian networks and causal graphical models.
sources.reportedScope: Inference, parameter estimation, model validation, simulation and causal/probabilistic graphical models.

sources.title: NASA ProgPy — prognostics framework
sources.potentialUse: Research reference for state estimation, prediction, uncertainty propagation and RUL evaluation as a separate module.
sources.reportedScope: Prognostics models and algorithms for selected engineering components.
sources.licenseStatus: README identifies NASA Open Source Agreement (NOSA) and links license.pdf; PDF obligations not reviewed
sources.accessStatus: README reviewed; linked license PDF not text-inspected

sources.title: MIMII baseline
sources.potentialUse: Potential acoustic anomaly baseline for pumps, valves and fans; not root-cause diagnosis.
sources.reportedScope: MIMII benchmark context; exact file tree was not confirmed in this pass.
sources.licenseStatus: not-verified; code and dataset terms must be checked separately
sources.accessStatus: README.md and LICENSE path fetches returned NOT_FOUND through the inspected route

sources.title: UCI Condition Monitoring of Hydraulic Systems (ID 447)
sources.potentialUse: Isolated benchmark for hydraulic-system condition classification and valve wear; not textual troubleshooting knowledge.
sources.reportedScope: UCI dataset ID 447; hydraulic system sensor cycles. Original UCI dataset page must be checked for current attribution and redistribution terms.
sources.licenseStatus: catalogue lists CC-BY; verify current UCI terms before redistribution
sources.accessStatus: Dataset referenced by JonMuel repository README; data files not imported

sources.title: Hydraulic Condition Monitoring — reproducible ML case study
sources.potentialUse: Study time-series feature extraction, group-aware validation and serving pattern for valve wear.
sources.reportedScope: UCI hydraulic condition monitoring dataset; notebook, exported model, FastAPI demo.
sources.licenseStatus: repository code MIT; UCI dataset terms are separate

sources.title: ARX-MFCM hydraulic propulsion dataset
sources.potentialUse: Research-only hydraulic fault-class evaluation after permission and duplicate handling.
sources.reportedScope: 50 simulation workbooks, five states, 6001 points/record; README reports 30 unique numeric records and 11 duplicate groups crossing the stated train/test split.
sources.accessStatus: README reviewed; workbook content not independently evaluated
